resources.string: To float the mini companion pill over Pokémon GO, please grant "Display over other apps" permission.

Next, Android will ask if PoGo Companion can see your screen. Tap “Start now”.

What that allows: tapping ⚡ SCAN reads one picture of the screen to find the Pokémon, its CP and appraisal. If you turn on AUTO, it keeps reading while you swipe through your Pokémon, and stops by itself when you stop.

Everything is read on this phone. Your scanned Pokémon are saved in My Log on this phone only, never uploaded. The only thing the app contacts is our update site, to check for a new version.

Android asks once each time you start the pill. Closing the pill stops it.
Pill on the side. Drag it across the screen to switch sides.
The pill will appear in your screenshots.
The pill is kept out of screenshots and screen recordings.
Pill as a bar across the top. Drag it up or down.
